new_value: {"notes":"Decision Mark 2026-11-12: crate-jmap aims to be THE complete reference implementation covering the JMAP specs, so this is required work, not optional. Split rule: the crates own wire types, validation, method semantics and error mapping; storage-, transport- or media-specific work is pushed to the calling crate through backend trait hooks (see the spec-method-defaults memory: no no-op default when that would put wrong data on the wire). This replaces 'Optional work' in the description. Here: EmailPushConfig/EmailPush types, PushSubscription/set validation, filter matching, property selection and push splitting live in the crates; the actual push delivery stays with the caller (crate-jmap-web-push or a caller backend)."}
